title: Ukrainian Beet Dumplings
description: A hearty and comforting Ukrainian-inspired dish featuring beet-filled dumplings. Serve with a dollop of sour cream for an added touch.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine flour and salt.
Add the egg, water, and mix until dough forms.
Knead the dough for about 10 minutes until smooth.
Divide the dough into smaller pieces, about 1/4 cup each.
Roll out each piece into a thin circle.
Spoon a tablespoon of beet mixture onto one half of the dough circle.
Fold the dough over the filling and press edges together to seal.
Repeat with the remaining dough and filling.
Boil the dumplings in salted water for about 10-12 minutes, or until they float to the surface.
Serve with a dollop of velvety sour cream.
